items: Spacious U-Shaped Design for Social Spaces - This 111.4"W U-shaped sectional features two center seats and two chaise lounges, offering 92.5" total seating width. Perfect for family gatherings or friend parties, it fits comfortably in apartments and larger living rooms, creating a versatile entertainment hub without overwhelming your space.

Luxurious Chenille Fabric - Experience cloud-like comfort with premium chenille upholstery—skin-friendly, breathable, and durable. Cushions combine high-density foam with spring pack technology for optimal support, gently conforming to your body. Holds up to 1000 lbs, ensuring lasting comfort for households with kids or pets.

Robust Construction & Smart Features - Built with a solid wood frame and reinforced connectors, this sofa ensures exceptional stability and durability. The 9.5" leg height allows robot vacuums to pass underneath easily, while foot pads protect floors and reduce noise. Enjoy peace of mind with a sturdy foundation that withstands daily use.

Easy & Quick Assembly - All numbered parts, tools, and clear instructions are included—no extra tools required. Most customers assemble this sectional fast and good, even sharing the fun with a partner. The straightforward setup means you can start enjoying your new sofa quickly and hassle-free.

Versatile Comfort for Every Home - Ideal for renters, small apartments, or creating cozy corners, this U-shaped sectional offers generous 92.5" seating width. The smart design balances spacious comfort with compact living, making it perfect for intimate conversations or relaxing with family. Transform your living space today!
